## About {.section-label}

I'm a Data Science Lecturer in the
[Statistics Department](https://www.stat.ubc.ca/)
at the
[University of British Columbia](https://www.ubc.ca/),
where I also teach in the
[Master of Data Science](https://masterdatascience.ubc.ca/) program.
Before UBC I was a Data Science Educator and Developer Advocate at
[Posit, PBC](https://posit.co/).
I wrote *Pandas for Everyone*,
and I've been teaching people to code since my
[Carpentries](https://carpentries.org/)
days in 2014.
